reason: The monoclinic approximately 7 A cell, Z=1 composition, density, central-S/Te framework, and short-contact geometry are credible, and the idealized Cu-vacancy enumeration favors the submitted P2 ordering (up to a diffraction-equivalent mirror-domain mate). Exact recovery is not sufficiently established, however: no comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied; the reported 0.0293 value is a custom residual from a fixed-profile calculation restricted to 10-63 degrees although the data extend from 5-90 degrees; and only the winning P2 realization received the final 14-parameter coordinate refinement, so the competing P-1/Pm vacancy orderings and other symmetry realizations were not compared under equivalent refinement. Thus the cell and average framework are much better supported than the submitted symmetry and refined coordinates, and another full-range, consistently refined solution attempt is warranted.
